title: Mahajanapada capitals
blurb: The capital cities of the great kingdoms of about 600 BCE, in the lists of the early Buddhist texts.
source: Public facts (places and dates), listed by hand with the notes written for this site; positions taken from Wikidata where it has the place
licence: Facts, no copyright; positions from Wikidata (CC0)

items.name: Rajagriha
items.detail: Early capital of Magadha, now Rajgir; Pataliputra (Patna) replaced it.
items.ask: Find the early capital of Magadha

items.name: Shravasti
items.detail: Capital of Kosala, where the Buddha spent many rainy seasons.

items.name: Vaishali
items.detail: Capital of the Vajji confederacy, one of the first republics.
items.ask: Find the capital of the Vajji confederacy

items.name: Kushinagar
items.detail: A centre of the Malla republic, where the Buddha died.
items.ask: Find the Malla republic, where the Buddha died

items.name: Kaushambi
items.detail: Capital of Vatsa, on the Yamuna.

items.name: Indraprastha
items.detail: Capital of Kuru, taken to be near today's Purana Qila in Delhi.

items.name: Ahichhatra
items.ask: Find the northern capital of Panchala

items.name: Viratanagar
items.detail: Capital of Matsya, near Jaipur in Rajasthan.

items.name: Mathura
items.detail: Capital of Surasena, on the Yamuna.

items.name: Potali
items.detail: Capital of Assaka, on the Godavari, the one Mahajanapada south of the Vindhyas; near Bodhan.
